title: Frans Hals Museum
geometryBasis: Native BAG-based outlines 265269331 and 265269196 establish the masonry and courtyard edges. The marked museum node and official national monument 19195 confirm the correct entrance. AHN's roof heights distinguish the four existing ranges.
sectionBasis: Reviewed the exact 1961 De Boer street and courtyard campaign, the elevated courtyard view and the untrimmed archive master of the photo originally published in Qualla. Measured roof heights from the national AHN 0.5 m surface model.
limitations: Models the principal historic museum at its Hof address. The separate Hal and individually mapped adjoining buildings are outside the site model.
The courtyard, grouped shutters, masonry, entry work and varying roofs follow the archive and survey. Fine ornament, roof tile joints and nonprincipal outer walls are representative.
